claim: Prenatal exposure to maternal stress is estimated to affect 10–35% of children worldwide.
source: Prenatal exposure to maternal stress is estimated to affect 10–35% of children worldwide, which is a major concern because early life stress may contribute to impaired cognitive development, negative affectivity, autism spectrum disorder (ASD), and psychiatric diagnoses including attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), addiction, depression, and schizophrenia (Van den Bergh et al., 2017).
evidence: The claim is supported by a citation to Van den Bergh et al., 2017.
